capabilities: Drag nodes and draw connections on a canvas
Generate Mermaid code from the visual layout
Round-trip existing Mermaid blocks while keeping comments and frontmatter
Group nodes into nested subgraphs and apply classDef styles
Draft flowcharts from natural-language prompts with an AI provider
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid renderer or theme; it is a visual node-and-edge editor that writes Mermaid code.
extras: AI generation is optional and needs a provider key or a local server. The roadmap lists PNG/SVG export and visual editing for sequence, mindmap and ER diagrams as not yet done.
intentEvidence: Mermaid Flow writes the underlying mermaid code for you, so no syntax knowledge is required.
problem: Hand-writing and rearranging Mermaid flowchart syntax is slow, and changing a diagram's layout means editing code by hand.
